backend/main.mo: Actor implementing access control, user approval, profiles, and daily service report storage with admin‑gated reset and allowlist‑based admin detection.
backend/migration.mo: Minimal migration module providing a no‑op migration from an old actor state containing an admin signup password.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing affected frontend files and components related to removing admin signup password messaging.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend source file in the project.
frontend/ANDROID_TWA_BUILD.md: Guide explaining how to package the PWA as an Android TWA app using Bubblewrap or manual Android Studio setup.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Detailed deployment instructions for local and mainnet environments with build version requirements and post-deploy checks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color variables and dark‑mode mappings for the app theme.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the app root, manifest, icons, theme color, and main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: Web app manifest defining app metadata, PWA settings, theme colors, and required icon assets.
frontend/public/sw.js: Implements a versioned service worker with precaching, runtime caching, cache cleanup, skip-waiting handling, and network-first or cache-first fetch strategies.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the main React app with routing, authentication guards, query client, and layout structure.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Displays a styled access‑restricted message with a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Renders the top navigation bar with auth controls, user info, and admin links based on permissions.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Defines the page layout including header, banners, main content area, and footer with build info.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Controls access to protected content by handling login state, profile loading, and error or setup flows.
frontend/src/components/OfflineBanner.ts: Shows an offline alert banner when network connectivity is lost.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Provides a signup form for creating a user profile with validation, error handling, and success flow.
frontend/src/components/ServiceWorkerUpd: Shows a banner when a new service worker version is available and offers a reload button to apply updates.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Displays a session error message and triggers full logout to return the user to sign-in.
frontend/src/components/SignupPendingAcc: Shows a pending access screen and allows retrying profile fetch with loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates an authenticated or anonymous backend actor via React Query and refreshes dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Provides a full logout flow that clears all auth state, caches, storage, and optionally reloads or resets the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts: Captures the user's geolocation once with timeout handling and exposes status and error state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity login, stored identity restoration, and status tracking through a React context provider.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalActor.ts: Initializes a backend actor using local session auth and invalidates dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalSessionAuth.t: Handles local session identity creation, persistence, restoration, and logout through a React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts: Tracks online/offline network status using browser events.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, admin status, and service reports using a local actor and session auth.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceWorkerUpdat: Provides a hook to detect service worker updates, expose an apply function, and reload the app when a new version is activated.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration defining light and dark theme color variables, global styles, and base typography.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Implements the admin user management page with user listing, deletion, reset actions, and admin access checks.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a specific service report with loading, error handling, and navigation controls.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Renders a form for creating service reports with validation, geolocation capture, and submit handling using a createReport hook.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Displays and filters report history with search, date range, user filtering, CSV download, and clipboard support, handling auth errors and session invalidation.

frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Detects whether errors represent missing profiles, pending access, or genuine authentication failures using pattern matching.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears all localStorage and sessionStorage entries as part of full auth/session reset.
frontend/src/utils/buildInfo.ts: Generates a build/version identifier from environment variables or module URL and exposes it for UI display.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Copies text to the clipboard using the modern API with a textarea fallback for older browsers.
frontend/src/utils/ensureNoInternetIdent: Runs IndexedDB and AuthClient session cleanup to prevent automatic Internet Identity reauthentication.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Provides helpers for formatting principal IDs and usernames for display.
frontend/src/utils/localSessionIdentityS: Saves, loads, and clears an Ed25519 identity in localStorage for local session persistence.
frontend/src/utils/pwaCacheCleanup.ts: Clears all PWA caches and unregisters service workers using best‑effort operations during system reset.
frontend/src/utils/reportDownload.ts: Creates CSV data from DailyServiceReport entries and triggers a file download with a timestamped filename.

frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Contains basic validation helpers for required fields, email format, and mobile number rules.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, including session‑backed storage and hash‑based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugin setup.
